title: [nightly/library] Report server errors to Sentry (off until SENTRY_DSN is set)
summary: Adds sentry-sdk so server failures (most often in the scan pipeline's calls to Mistral, Gemini and GolfCourseAPI) reach an error tracker with stack traces, grouped by cause. It's off until SENTRY_DSN is set, works with sentry.io's free plan or self-hosted GlitchTip, and scrubs bodies, headers, IPs, emails and log arguments.
stillOpen: Couldn't open the PR: the run had no GitHub access. Written against frontend-refactor before the redesign merge, so it needs porting onto factory/library-feature.
reviewFirst: What's sent and what isn't: scrub_event drops log arguments and request data.
Exception messages are sent as they are and can carry data.
